author: Bramans
description:
A wild boar in Oberursel, Hessen Germany.
The wild boar (Sus scrofa), also known as wild swine or Eurasian wild pig, is a suid native to much of Eurasia, North Africa, and the Greater Sunda Islands. Human intervention has spread its distribution further, making the species one of the widest-ranging mammals in the world, as well as the most widely spread suiform.
